concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-void-node]] - Node.js `transaction.void()` reference for `authorized` and `submitted for settlement` transactions, PayPal-only `settlement pending` eligibility, and the if-possible authorization-reversal effect
warnings: Keep `settlement pending` eligibility scoped to PayPal transactions; do not generalize it to every payment method.
Keep the authorization reversal qualified as `if possible`; do not promise reversal or removal of the pending charge in every void.
This source documents voiding, not refund behavior; do not merge the two lifecycle operations.
